days.title: High Peaks and Weather Stations
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Botrange
stops.detail: At 694 m O.P., the Botrange is both the highest elevation in the High Fens and the highest mountain in Belgium.

stops.name: Richelsley
stops.detail: The elevations of the Fens are monadnocks, which essentially consist of these quartzite sandstones: Botrange, Pannensterz, Richelsley, Steling, Kaiser Karls Bettstatt, Hoscheit and Langschoß.
